proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL ghuṭa subsection 2 ghuṇṭa explicitly gives Kumaoni ghuno knee, Nepali ghũṛo and Gujarati ghũṭaṇ knee. Dotyali gũṇā̃/ghuṇā/ghũṇā/ghudā and Majhi/Bote ghõḍa/ghõra/ghũḍa/ghora knee fit this nasal regional branch, with source aspiration, nasalization, retroflex stop/rhotic and final-vowel notation preserved and qualified. The separately numbered ghuṭṭa Hindi ghuṭnā branch is not substituted merely on the knee gloss. Regional IA transmission and local phonetic developments remain unresolved. Exact response: gũṇā̃.
